'''Aris''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Albarrio system/Legends|Albarrio system]] of the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]]<ref name="RM" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> It was a world of [[Tree/Legends|rainforests]], and home to the [[Monkey/Legends|monkey]]-like scavenger known as the [[Wok-Wok]]. It served as the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Albarrio sector, and was a stop along the [[Relgim Run/Legends|Relgim Run]]. It had no native intelligent life, but had been colonized.<ref name="RM" />
